summary: 14 errors, 32 minor. Units with errors: 5 (gnāvaḥ, suvīryam, added words, बल vs host), 8 (patyase root, daśa, line b guesswork), 10 (viśikṣu root), 15 (pṛkṣaḥ). Recurring problem: bracketed additions in Hindi. No regrouping needed. Glossary proposals: vidatha = rite (यज्ञ, not 'सभा'); brahman priest = Brahman priest (ब्रह्मा); gir = hymn; names Aryaman/Aṃśa/Bhaga/Pūṣan/Savitṛ/Tvaṣṭṛ in plain IAST; Hindi iṣṭi = अर्पण, pṛkṣ = पोषण; kṣumant = abounding; vāja = prize (पुरस्कार).
